parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Depends on status. Live: ending (default), fastest, backed. Upcoming: opening (default), interest. Ended: recent (default), best, backed.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Only presales associated with this on-chain partner object ID. This is not an API-key account name or wallet address. Omit to include all partners.

schema.description: Canonical on-chain object ID: 0x followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results per page; between 1 and 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The non-null continuation token from the previous response. Keep all filters unchanged.

parameters.name: verified_team
parameters.description: Set true to require a verified team. Omit to include both.

parameters.name: audited
parameters.description: Set true to require an audit. Omit to include both.

parameters.name: presaleId
parameters.description: Canonical on-chain object ID. Example IDs may not exist on mainnet.

schema.description: Canonical on-chain object ID: 0x followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

parameters.name: presale
parameters.description: Repeat for up to 50 unique presale IDs. Provide at least one presale or coin.

items.description: Canonical on-chain object ID: 0x followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

parameters.name: coin
parameters.description: Repeat for up to four unique coin types. Only supported with window=24h.

items.description: Canonical Move coin type. URL-encode when used in a path.

parameters.name: points
parameters.description: Sampling density. Boundary observations may add points; output length is not fixed.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searchable text or a canonical identifier.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Omit to search applicable groups. Identifier queries can include onchain and wallets. Must be applicable to q.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results per page; between 1 and 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Continue section.data.nextCursor for one group. Requires group; preserve q.
